Skip the Vape. Keep the Vibe.

Overview

An anti-vaping T-shirt collection designed for Design Hero 2024: OK (E) CIGARETTES ?, a project by the Thai Health Promotion Foundation (ThaiHealth) and art4d. Distinctive, brightly coloured illustrations aim to start conversations about vaping.

Problem

E-cigarettes can be seen as part of an attractive lifestyle, especially when tied to trends, peer acceptance and self-expression.

Design challenge

How can a T-shirt challenge the idea that vaping is cool while still being something young people actually want to wear?

Concept

1. Skip the Vape. Keep the Vibe. (concept for the campaign): stylish, confident and fully yourself, no vape required. 2. Sing Om Kwan, Kwan Om Sing (concept for the illustration): from wanting to be a heavy smoker to becoming the one swallowed by the smoke.

Visual direction

Smoke is the core element. Its playful, eye-catching shapes are reinterpreted as a trap that slowly wraps around and swallows the smoker.

Designer : Ammily Prain
